title.narrative: 1. Rural households in the ASAL Counties achieve better health outcomes attributable to improved access to and use of clean & safe drinking water

description.narrative: Community managed water systems engaged in PPCPs supply clean and potable drinking water to the communities in the target counties and as resulting in better health of the community

title.narrative: Percent of rural households adopting safe water practices

description.narrative: The indicator will be measured as an output of the safe water (clean & potable water) awareness creation activities to be conducted at community sensitisation stage. The hygiene practices to be promoted shall include; washing of hands, cleaning of kitchen ware with clean water, etc. The percent shall be computed by: Number of HHDs practicing safe water practices/ Total Num. of HHDs X100%

title.narrative: Percentage change in households reported incidences of waterborne related diseases in the targeted ASAL counties

description.narrative: The indicator measures the extent to which consumption of clean and safe drinking water contributes to better health outcomes. The household survey will assess whether any of the household members ever suffered from water borne related diseases such as cholera, dialarhoea, typhoid etc. The reported cases shall be expressed as a percent with the total number of benefitting HHDs as the denominator

title.narrative: 3. Water Sector Trust Fund (WSTF) institutionalises the PPCP approach and other private sector participation approaches.

description.narrative: SNV through its team of key experts and nonkey experts will build the capacity of the WSTF on various models of private sector participation e.g. PPCPs, PPPs, PBCs etc. We will support the WSTF developing a PPCP strategy/toolkit for dissemination to various water actors interested in implementing the PPCP model as well as supporting them in establishing and operationalising PPCP frameworks and systems within the WSTF.

title.narrative: 1. Counties adopt PPCP models in management of water systems

description.narrative: SNV through their key experts will conduct relevant workshops and trainings to the target counties and get them to buyin into the various Public Private Community Partnership models. Based on the scoping of the nonkey experts (technical support) the key experts will support the counties in implementing the PPCP models based on viability assessments. The key experts will also support the target counties to establish PPCP structures/systems and with the help of the M&E specialist support the counties to adopt the approach i.e., developing county service monitoring tools. Finally, under this activity we will support counties to sign PPCP contracts with relevant stakeholders.

title.narrative: 1.5 Hours of water supply

description.narrative: Hours of Supply refers to the average number of hours per day that a utility provides water to its customers. It measures the continuity of services of a utility and thus the availability of water to the customer. It is an important indicator on quality of service and shows the extent to which the utility is making progress towards the fulfilment of the human right to water in terms of availability

description.narrative: SNV through their key experts will conduct relevant workshops and trainings to the target counties and get them to buyin into the various Public Private Community Partnership models. Based on the scoping of the nonkey experts (technical support) the key experts will support the counties in implementing the PPCP models based on viability assessments. The key experts will also support the target counties to establish PPCP structures/systems and with the help of the M&E specialist support the counties to adopt the approach i.e., developing county service monitoring tools. Finally, under this activity we will support counties to sign PPCP contracts with relevant stakeholders.

title.narrative: Arid and Semiarid household communities are more resilient to droughts leading to improved food security

description.narrative: The resilience of ASAL communities will be strengthened by improving water services provision through collaboration between public and private sectors, by adopting innovative PPCP management approaches, promoting climate smart technologies e.g. solar water pumps which are crucial to ensure climate resiliency, service improvement for underserved and unserved populations, facilitating regulatory changes and supporting emergence of alternative market based financing.

title.narrative: Mean household food insecurity experience scale across households in the targeted ASAL Counties

description.narrative: The indicator is aligned with the Global Food Security Index (GFSI) to inform the food security situation in the ASAL counties.Food Insecurity Experience Scale (FIES) will be measured in a Survey Module of 8 questions over a reference period of 1 year. A sample of households benefitting from EDECPIRA interventions will be surveyed. Individual scores will be used to estimate the prevalence of food insecurity at moderate and severe levels in the population which will be presented as a number. Attribution of change to EDECPIRA interventions will require supporting mixed methods analysis.
